name: What preparation is needed to market my luxury home internationally?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed to market my luxury home internationally?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your luxury home for international marketing, ensure your property is professionally staged, photographed, and video-toured to showcase its best features. Gather all relevant property documents, including floor plans and any recent appraisals, as international buyers often require comprehensive details upfront. Consider an inspection to address any potential issues. This thorough preparation is crucial for presenting a compelling asset to a global audience and streamlining the due diligence process for international clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by professionally staging, photographing, and video-touring your home, and gathering all property documents to provide comprehensive details to international buyers.
